SELECT temp_case AS "°F" FROM climate WHERE temp_case IS NOT NULL AND ts > now() - interval '48 hours' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT value AS "State", COUNT(*) AS "Count" FROM system_state WHERE entity = 'greenhouse_state' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY value ORDER BY 2 DESC

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time,
    avg(temp_avg) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Indoor (15-sample rolling avg)"
FROM climate
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND temp_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts

(SELECT ts AS time, outdoor_temp_f AS "Outdoor Forecast"
 FROM climate WHERE outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (date_trunc('hour', ts))
     date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time,
     temp_f::float AS "Outdoor Forecast"
 FROM weather_forecast
 WHERE ts > now() AND ts < now() + interval '72 hours'
 ORDER BY date_trunc('hour', ts), fetched_at DESC)
ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__time(ts), enthalpy_delta AS "ΔH (kJ/kg)" FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND enthalpy_delta IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END AS "Vent" FROM (
  SELECT ts, state FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='vent' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  UNION ALL
  -- seed: long-hold relays (vent stayed open 10h on 2026-07-12) have no
  -- transitions inside short windows; carry the state at window start
  SELECT $__timeFrom(), state FROM (
    SELECT state FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='vent' AND ts <= $__timeFrom()
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) seed
) x ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 'Blocked' ELSE 'Available' END AS "Economiser" FROM (
  SELECT ts, state FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='economiser_blocked' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  UNION ALL
  -- seed: long-hold relays (vent stayed open 10h on 2026-07-12) have no
  -- transitions inside short windows; carry the state at window start
  SELECT $__timeFrom(), state FROM (
    SELECT state FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='economiser_blocked' AND ts <= $__timeFrom()
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) seed
) x ORDER BY ts

Band: Device (on-chip) vs DB (served) — VPD  [issue 2: device truth, not just DB intent]
panels.description: The DEVICE's resolved on-chip VPD band (setpoint_snapshot readback) overlaid on the DB-served band (fn_band_setpoints). Every other compliance panel plots only the DB band; this one shows what the ESP32 is actually enforcing, so a firmware-vs-DB curve skew or unsynced anchor is VISIBLE (and alarmed via band_device_db_divergence) instead of showing false GREEN. device==db means the on-chip curve matches the DB.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  h.ts AS time,
  h.value AS "device vpd_high (on-chip)",
  (SELECT vpd_high FROM fn_band_setpoints(h.ts)) AS "db vpd_high (served)",
  l.value AS "device vpd_low (on-chip)",
  (SELECT vpd_low FROM fn_band_setpoints(h.ts)) AS "db vpd_low (served)"
FROM setpoint_snapshot h
JOIN setpoint_snapshot l ON l.ts=h.ts AND l.parameter='vpd_low' AND l.greenhouse_id='vallery'
WHERE h.parameter='vpd_high' AND h.greenhouse_id='vallery' AND $__timeFilter(h.ts)
ORDER BY h.ts
